class.name: CgameCPUBudget
class.brief_description: Splits a per-frame CPU time budget between registered systems.
class.description: Systems register a [code]priority[/code], a guaranteed [code]min_ms[/code] and a [code]desired_ms[/code] cap. [method allocate] first grants every system its minimum (scaled down proportionally if the minima alone exceed the budget), then shares the remainder by priority using water-filling: a system never receives more than its demand and the surplus is redistributed. A system's demand is its [code]desired_ms[/code] until usage is reported with [method report_usage]; afterwards it is the exponentially smoothed usage multiplied by [member headroom], clamped to [code][min_ms, desired_ms][/code]. Idle systems therefore yield time to busy ones.

method.name: allocate
method.description: Splits [param frame_budget_ms] and returns the allocation in milliseconds keyed by system name. The result is remembered for [method allocation_ms] and [method over_budget].

method.name: allocation_ms
method.description: Returns the share granted by the last [method allocate] call.

method.name: demand_ms
method.description: Returns the current demand of a system after adaptation.

method.name: over_budget
method.description: Returns the systems whose smoothed usage exceeds their last allocation, worst overshoot first.

method.name: register_system
method.description: Registers or replaces a system. [param desired_ms] is raised to at least [param min_ms].

method.name: report_usage
method.description: Feeds measured usage of a system into its smoothed estimate.

method.name: smoothed_usage_ms
method.description: Returns the smoothed usage of a system, or [code]0[/code] if none was reported.

method.name: system_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered systems.

method.name: unregister_system
method.description: Removes a system and its allocation.

members.member: Multiplier applied to smoothed usage to compute demand.
Weight of a new sample in the exponential moving average of usage, between [code]0[/code] and [code]1[/code].
